answer: Sybil resistance employs costly Proof-of-Work identity registration. Each AI agent must expend significant computational resources, a beacon of effort like a lantern in the network fog. This makes replicating identities akin to carving unique karst formations from bedrock, requiring immense, non-reusable work. An attacker would need to match this deep computational cost for each identity, rendering any identity whisper expensive, ensuring attack infeasibility.
